Name: TorchRing
Author: sskerye
Description:
火把现在可以装备在戒指槽中，让你在照亮周围时仍能使用手中的工具。 每个戒指槽可装备一个火把，Wear More Rings 增加的戒指槽也可以使用。装备多个火把时，每增加一个火把都会继续扩大照明范围；

Torches can now be equipped in ring slots, lighting up your surroundings while you use your tools. Each ring slot can hold one torch, including extra slots added by Wear More Rings. Every additional torch you equip further increases your light radius.
